verdict.rationale: USPTO documents a public form previews page where TEAS forms can be viewed without logging in, before the account wall that applies to actual filing. The evidence describes previewing, not downloading, and covers trademark forms only, with no evidence of downloadable instructions or patent forms. Missing for 10: explicit downloadable form files (e.g. PDF), downloadable filing instructions accessible without an account, patent-side form access, independent/hands-on corroboration.
